A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Chimera study and contain complete main text and appendices. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the equations, tables, figures and appendix examples.

before.justification: v1 reports original Chimera reasoning and structural-extraction evaluations in Tables 3–9, an expert-scaling ablation in Appendix Table 12, and qualitative extraction outputs.

after.justification: v2 retains these original evaluations, ablations and qualitative outputs, including results for both Chimera-Reasoner and Chimera-Extractor.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same generalist and specialist branches, router, GSCM masking, training objectives, two-stage training procedure and Reasoner/Extractor variants.

E1.justification: Training datasets in Tables 1–2 and evaluation coverage on MathVista, MathVerse, ChartQA-SE, PlotQA-SE, Table-SE and Doc-SE are unchanged. Appendix Section 6 retains the same table and document populations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the reasoning and extraction comparisons in Tables 3–8. The naive-finetuning comparison in Table 9 and chart-only expert comparison in Table 12 are also retained.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix Sections 6 and 8 retain the same evaluation splits, metrics, sample counts, preprocessing, model sizes and training budgets. The configurations in Tables 13–14 are identical.

E4.justification: The masking-ratio ablation in Table 9, expert-scaling ablation in Table 12, domain/category analyses in Table 5 and Figure 4, and qualitative cases in Figures 7–16 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests for Chimera's evaluations. Uncertainty-reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative outputs are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Chimera-Reasoner-8B retains accuracies of 64.9 on MathVista and 32.4 on MathVerse in Tables 3–4.

T1.justification: The expert-set, routing, input-sequence and loss formulations in Equations 1–9 are unchanged. Neither version adds further theoretical results or proofs in the appendices.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about scalable expert integration, GSCM alignment, reasoning performance and specialist-level extraction capabilities. The stated contributions are unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the explanations of optimization imbalance, table-expert task mismatch, general-domain benefits and excessive-masking effects. The discussion of conflicts between experts in Appendix Section 7 is also unchanged.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the project homepage from unimodal4reasoning.github.io/chimera_page/ to alpha-innovator.github.io/chimera_page. Implementation details and the promised release of weights and datasets remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish new resource availability.

R1.justification: Section 2 retains the same discussion of generalist and specialist models and Chimera's positioning relative to them. The cited works and reference list are unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 corrects 'MathViata' to 'MathVista' in the Figure 1 caption and adds a missing space before InternVL2 in Section 4.2. The narrative and section organization remain unchanged, with minor reflow and updated version/date text.

P2.justification: The Figure 1 caption is corrected, and changed line wrapping shifts text on pages 1–3. Figure artwork, table structures and all appendix displays remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The homepage address update, caption correction and spacing edits provide only small administrative and typographic refinements. The method, empirical support, interpretations and substantive reproducibility information remain unchanged, yielding no meaningful overall quality difference.
